# CLI cheatsheet

## Common commands

```bash
dn kickstart <issue-url>         # plan + implement
dn meld <issue-url>              # plan only (dn-outer)
dn loop plans/task.plan.md       # implement from plan
dn land [plan]                   # CLI close-out into VCS
dn land --skip-review [plan]
dn land --single [plan]
dn fixup <pr-url>
dn meld a.md b.md --plan-name merged
dn init stack 42
dn sync
dn sync --pr --issue <n>
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `--agent <harness>:<model>` | Nested harness selection |
| `--context-file <path>` | Prompt context (repeatable) |
| `--unattended` / `--ci` | Non-interactive |
| `--trace` / `--no-trace` | Agent stream |
| `--no-color` / `--color` | ANSI |
| `--json` | JSON output where supported |

### Agent selection priority

1. `--agent <harness>:<model>`
2. `DN_AGENT`
3. `CURSOR_ENABLED=1`, `CLAUDE_ENABLED=1`, `CODEX_ENABLED=1`, `COPILOT_ENABLED=1`
4. `dn.json` `harness.defaults.agent` (legacy `agent`)
5. OpenCode default

## Tokens

1. `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `DANGEROUS_GITHUB_TOKEN`
2. `gh auth token`
3. `dn auth` cache in `~/.config/dn/`

## Environment

- `ISSUE` — kickstart/meld fallback
- `WORKSPACE_ROOT`
- `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- `PR_URL` — fixup
- `PLAN` — loop

## RFCs

```bash
dn rfc list
```

- `rfcs/` for durable why/how; `plans/` for single-issue execution
- `dn init agents --skill rfc --agent <harness>`
- `dn init wizard --project` / `dn rfc init`
